articles.title: BigQuery Graph is now GA the knowledge foundation for the agentic era
articles.summary: Google Cloud announces BigQuery Graph, a graph database that unlocks insights across connected data, enabling AI agents to answer complex questions.
articles.detail: BigQuery Graph allows users to analyze relationships between data entities, creating a knowledge foundation for AI applications. This enables AI agents to answer complex questions and make informed decisions.

articles.title: From weeks to minutes The new agentic era of data pipelines
articles.summary: Google Cloud introduces a new framework for building data pipelines, enabling data professionals to create and deploy pipelines in less time.
articles.detail: The new framework allows users to build data pipelines in minutes, rather than weeks, making it easier to integrate data sources and deploy AI models.

articles.title: Nvidia investing $35 billion in MediaTek for AI chip partnership
articles.summary: NVIDIA is investing $3.5 billion in MediaTek to expand their collaboration on AI chips, covering data centers, PCs, and automotive.
articles.detail: The partnership will accelerate the development of AI-enabled chips, driving innovation across industries and solidifying NVIDIA's position as a leader in AI computing.

articles.title: AWS and NVIDIA to Deliver 2 Million Additional GPUs and NextGeneration Infrastructure for Agentic and Physical AI
articles.summary: Amazon Web Services (AWS) and NVIDIA are expanding their collaboration to meet surging global demand for AI infrastructure.
articles.detail: The partnership will deliver 2 million additional GPUs and next-generation infrastructure, enabling faster deployment of AI models and accelerating innovation in fields like healthcare and climate science.

articles.title: Amazon EC2 R9g and R9gd instances powered by AWS Graviton5 processors are now generally available
articles.summary: AWS announces the general availability of Amazon EC2 R9g and R9gd instances, delivering up to 25% better compute performance than R8g.
articles.detail: The new instances are ideal for databases, in-memory caches, and real-time analytics, offering customers a high-performance computing option.

articles.title: [In preview] Public Preview Azure Multicloud Interconnect
articles.summary: Azure announces the public preview of Azure Multicloud Interconnect, a managed service providing private connectivity between Azure and supported cloud providers.
articles.detail: The service enables customers to connect their Azure workloads with AWS resources, offering a seamless multicloud experience.

articles.title: NVIDIA Delivers Vera CPU Systems to Hyperscalers and AI Innovators
articles.summary: NVIDIA begins shipping its Vera CPU systems, designed for AI workloads and built in collaboration with hyperscalers and AI innovators.
articles.detail: The Vera CPU systems offer a significant leap in performance and efficiency, enabling faster deployment of AI models and accelerating innovation in fields like healthcare and climate science.

articles.title: [Launched] Generally Available Workload identity support for Azure Files CSI driver (SMB) in Azure
articles.summary: Azure announces the general availability of workload identity support for Azure Files Container Storage Interface (CSI) driver.
articles.detail: The feature enables pod-level authentication to SMB file shares, offering customers a more secure and efficient way to manage their storage workloads.

articles.title: Cloud CISO Perspectives Tips on securing the water sector in the AI era
articles.summary: Google Cloud shares security tips for the water sector, highlighting critical issues and actionable steps to secure infrastructure in the AI era.
articles.detail: The article emphasizes the importance of adopting a zero-trust architecture and implementing robust identity and access management controls.

articles.title: NVIDIA Announces Upcoming Event for Financial Community
articles.summary: NVIDIA announces an upcoming event for the financial community, offering insights into its business and strategy.
articles.detail: The event provides an opportunity for investors and analysts to engage with NVIDIA's leadership team and gain a deeper understanding of the company's vision and roadmap.

articles.title: AWS Weekly Roundup Welcome DuckLabs to the team, Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD), and more (August 31, 2026)
articles.summary: AWS summarizes its recent announcements, including the acquisition of DuckLabs and the introduction of Agentic Resource Discovery.
articles.detail: The roundup provides an overview of AWS's latest news and updates, covering a range of topics from AI to storage.

articles.title: [Launched] Generally Available Azure VM Image Builder in sovereign and air-gapped clouds
articles.summary: Azure announces the general availability of Azure VM Image Builder in sovereign and air-gapped clouds.
articles.detail: The service enables customers to create and manage customized VM images across various cloud environments, offering greater flexibility and control.

articles.title: GeForce NOW Gives Gamers More Ways to Play at Gamescom 2026
articles.summary: NVIDIA announces new features and capabilities for GeForce NOW, expanding its cloud gaming service.
articles.detail: The updates include support for more devices and platforms, as well as improved gameplay controls and performance.

articles.title: vPC and ESI-based multi-homing The dynamic duo powering scalable, resilient data centers
articles.summary: Cisco highlights the benefits of vPC and enhanced ESI-based multi-homing for building resilient and scalable data center networks.
articles.detail: The solution enables customers to create a fabric-native network that accelerates their data center infrastructure for the AI era.

articles.title: Prediction Marvell Stock Could Be on the Verge of Another Big Move
articles.summary: An analyst predicts that Marvell's stock may be poised for another significant increase, driven by its custom silicon bookings.
articles.detail: The article highlights Marvell's growth potential and its position in the AI infrastructure market.
